## Target context
- Repo: DontPanic
- Env: dev
- Project: (none)
- Command: 1 (see structured target_context.commands_run)

[F001] Side-effect commands invoked:

$ python3 -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_plan_cohesion_f001.py -q

**Findings addressed:**

- **medium/correctness — walker doesn't filter to locked plans** (auditor finding 1): Added `_LOCKED_PLAN_STATUSES = {"active", "ready_for_audit", "in_audit", "completed", "abandoned", "blocked"}` and an `_is_locked_plan()` predicate at `scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py:899`. The walker at `check_plan_cohesion()` now parses each candidate's frontmatter and skips anything that isn't post-lock — drafts are pre-lock by definition and drift there is expected. The PASS message now reads "N locked plan(s) ... internally consistent". Added `test_check_plan_cohesion_skips_draft_plans` which writes one drift-shaped plan in `status: draft` and another in `status: active` under the same root; only the locked one surfaces a finding, proving the filter is per-plan rather than blanket-suppressing.

- **medium/correctness — acceptance-vs-deferred didn't require token in parent_acceptance_item** (auditor finding 2): Tightened the check at `validate_plan_cohesion()` so it extracts resource tokens from BOTH the feature acceptance string AND `parent_acceptance_item`, then only warns on the intersection (when the parent also contains deferral language). Updated `_suggest_acceptance_fix`/finding-message accordingly. Updated the (b) plan-004 reproducer fixture to mention `jarvis-a6ee1` in the parent text so it aligns with the spec's intersection requirement. Add
